_comment: Rookie-draft ORDER rule per league (leagueKey). One owner: src/public_league/draft_order.py. A league absent here has an UNKNOWN rule and gets no draft-slot forecast (fails closed) — never assume every league uses reverse standings (OWNER_FEATURE_SPEC_RECONCILIATION_2026-08-13).

dynasty_main.description: Reverse final regular-season record: worst record picks first; teams tied on record are ordered by LOWER total regular-season Points For first, applied recursively through every tied group. Not Max PF, not all-play record, not Team Strength rank.
